target_moa.text: Maribavir is a first-in-class CMV pUL97 protein kinase inhibitor; it competitively inhibits pUL97 kinase (IC50 3 nM), blocking phosphorylation of proteins and inhibiting CMV DNA replication, encapsidation and nuclear egress.

citations.quote: Maribavir is a first-in-class cytomegalovirus (CMV) pUL97 kinase inhibitor.
maribavir inhibits the HCMV pUL97 protein kinase activity in a biochemical assay with a half maximal inhibitory concentration of 3nM.
It targets CMV pUL97, which not only results in inhibition of viral DNA replication, but also encapsidation and nuclear egress.

modality.text: small molecule (orally bioavailable benzimidazole riboside antiviral)

citations.quote: Maribavir is an orally bioavailable benzimidazole riboside antiviral with a novel mechanism of action against CMV.
